page.notes: The right part of the page is cut off, so the ends of the title lines and of some entries are missing; the visible parts are transcribed as printed. The Greek word in the entry "Ἀνάθημα" is read from a small scan and may be inexact. Some letters in "Afflictorum" and "Anack" are printed as ligatures and were read as plain letters. Handwritten marginal annotations in brown ink at the top and bottom of the page and across several lines are not transcribed. The scan is a second part of a page; the upper portion is cut off. Some lines in the header area are partly obscured.
